rules.usefulContribution: damage + effective healing + shield absorbed + prevented damage + control value
rules.expectedUnitContribution: team useful contribution / active unit count
rules.relativeStrength: unit useful contribution / expected unit contribution - 1
rules.strengthPerception: Use the supplied profile bands; positive input is capped at 150%.
rules.domainMagnitude: domain contribution / expected unit contribution * 100%; do not subtract 100% for traits
rules.traitRule: A trait is learned only when that domain magnitude reaches semantic level 3 or above.
rules.knowledgeRule: Keep immutable first impressions and append contradictory contextual observations. Separately synthesize a revisable current belief.
rules.priorityRule: Exact context evidence outranks general belief. General current belief weights every observation by reliability * (1 + 1 / observation order), so earlier evidence matters more but cannot permanently lock belief.

agentInterpretationPolicy.promotionRule: later structured evidence must validate the hypothesis before code may create knowledge
